Bangladesh unrest grows ahead of Sheikh Hasina's planned return

Bangladesh deployed hundreds of paramilitary troops and stepped up security nationwide on Wednesday amid protests and clashes triggered by the planned return of ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina. Reports allege supporters of her banned Awami League party carried out bomb blasts and arson attacks. Separately, Bangladesh dismissed a report suggesting India had set conditions for Hasina's extradition. Hasina herself stated she would return to Bangladesh in December, despite "threat of death."
